questions.question: In which year was the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) founded?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) was founded in the year **1928**__.
 
• The young men influenced by socialist ideas decided to set up a **nationwide revolutionary organization**. Prominent among them were **Chandrashekhar Azad, Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, Sukhdev,** etc. In **1928** in the meeting held at __**Feroz Shah Kotla ground in Delhi,**__ these young men established the organization called __**‘Hindustan Socialist Republican Association**__’.
 
• The **objective **behind the establishment of this organization was **to free India from British exploitation **and to overthrow the unjust socio-economic system which exploited the farmers and workers.
 
• The work of gathering arms and execution of programmes was entrusted to a separate wing of the organization. This wing was called **‘Hindustan Socialist Republican Army’** and **Chandrashekar Azad** was the chief of this wing.

questions.question: Who among the following was NOT a minister of Cabinet Mission Plan, 1946?
questions.solution:
After the end of the Second World War, the British rulers were in favor of granting freedom to India.

• The **three-member mission** visited India between **March and June 1946**. The delegation of British ministers included **Lord Pethick-Lawrence, Sir Stafford Cripps and Mr. A.V. Alexander.**

**Key Proposals of the Cabinet Mission Plan**__:

 
• Rejected the demand for a sovereign Pakistan.
 
• Grouping of existing assemblies into 3 sections A, B, C.
 
• Provincial autonomy and residual powers.
 
• Three-tier executive and legislature at the province, princely states, and union level.
